title: Session-holder registration requires coordinator ambient identity
subject: session-identity-authorization
ratio: Session-holder register and unregister are mechanically authorized: they succeed only when the ambient identity - never the --by flag, never the name being registered - is a coordinator identity (main, or a registry agent whose role is coordinator, read live from state.json; fail-closed on a missing or malformed registry). Cross-session self-registration is refused with exit 1 and logged as session_holder_register_refused. Registration is a deliberate, explicit coordinator act; nothing else in the harness may auto-register a holder.
dicta: Tier 2 on P-019, the accepted_mutations entry born from the T-042 forensic investigation plus the coordinator design decision; applied at T-053, verdicted done by verifier-b (done-event verified in events.jsonl). Primary home is the session.py module docstring, the trust-boundary statement; carried as the path: validity entry because a bare path is not a resolvable citation token. Frozen by the codification ledger row decision:T-377#cd-10.
scope_conditions: role:any agent invoking session.py register or unregister
revisit_trigger: Revisit if the coordinator-identity set definition changes or a non-coordinator registration path is sanctioned.
validity_conditions: register refuses non-coordinator ambient identities and logs the refusal
